_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Paris Peace Conference opens
events.desc: The victors meet to set the peace terms.

events.label: Treaty of Versailles
events.desc: Germany signs the peace treaty.

events.label: Covenant of the League of Nations comes into force
events.desc: The Covenant comes into force with the Treaty of Versailles.

events.label: Treaty of Sèvres
events.desc: The treaty partitioning the Ottoman Empire; it is never ratified by Turkey.

events.label: Anglo-Irish Treaty
events.desc: The treaty that creates the Irish Free State.

events.label: March on Rome
events.desc: Mussolini's Fascists march on the capital; the king appoints him prime minister.

events.label: Soviet Union founded
events.wiki: Treaty on the Creation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
events.desc: Russia, Ukraine, Belarus and Transcaucasia form the USSR.

events.label: Treaty of Lausanne
events.desc: The treaty that fixes the borders of modern Turkey.

events.label: Republic of Turkey proclaimed
events.desc: Mustafa Kemal becomes the first president.

events.label: Beer Hall Putsch
events.desc: Hitler's failed coup in Munich.

events.label: Locarno Treaties
events.desc: Germany, France and Belgium accept their common borders.

events.label: Wall Street Crash
events.desc: Share prices collapse in New York; the Great Depression follows.

events.label: Mukden Incident
events.desc: The Japanese army stages an explosion as a pretext to occupy Manchuria.

events.label: Hitler becomes Chancellor of Germany
events.desc: President Hindenburg appoints Hitler.

events.label: Reichstag fire
events.desc: The fire is used to suspend civil liberties in Germany.

events.label: Italy invades Ethiopia
events.desc: Italy conquers Ethiopia by May 1936.

events.label: Remilitarisation of the Rhineland
events.desc: German troops enter the demilitarised zone.

events.label: Spanish Civil War begins
events.desc: A military rising against the Republic starts a war that lasts until 1939.

events.label: Marco Polo Bridge Incident
events.desc: The clash that opens full-scale war between Japan and China.

events.label: Anschluss
events.desc: Germany annexes Austria.

events.label: Munich Agreement
events.desc: Britain, France and Italy agree to Germany's annexation of the Sudetenland.

events.label: Kristallnacht
events.desc: Synagogues and Jewish businesses are attacked across Germany.

events.label: Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact
events.desc: Germany and the Soviet Union sign a non-aggression pact with a secret protocol dividing eastern Europe.
